This website is built with asisted by Claude Code (claude.ai/code), where I mainly use for task involves:

- Inspire me by new mathematical tools when I was stuck by certain proof details during creating new proofs.
- Generate a quick demo code for quick check of ideas, better illustration of concepts, and a go-through explaination of algorithms.
- Do servey with **REAL** references attached.

Based on this, I separate my theoretical posts into two categories:

- **Readings**: The notes when I read a paper or certain proof details.
- **Surveys**: A general survey post about a specific topic in quantum computing. during the survey, some specific details will be picked out with a hyperlink to a **Reading** post.
- **Topics**: I will gradually collect **Readings** with similar topics into a **Topic** post, with a navigate bar on the left sidebar on that page.

## Topics Posts

This section sorts the posts by topics.
::: {.callout-tip}
Please click on the left sidebar (Sidebar) to browse specific knowledge categories.

Browse curated lecture notes organized by research topic. Each topic contains an index page with comprehensive introduction and linked sub-notes covering specific techniques and methods.

**Current Topics:**

- **[Shadow Tomography](/theory/Topics/Shadow_tomography/)** - Classical shadow protocols from single-copy to multi-copy strategies, variance analysis, and sample complexity bounds
- **[Lower Bounds](/theory/Topics/Lowerbounds/)** - Toolkit for proving information-theoretic lower bounds using Le Cam's method, POVM restrictions, and ensemble constructions
